summary: Backend regression and browser checks completed. Fixed two POST serialization 500s caused by Mongo ObjectId leakage; all five API tests now pass. Landing, auth, journal, and responsive mobile interactions were exercised; the browser script stopped at a test assertion because sensitive content intentionally hides its title before reveal.
action_items: Adjust the browser test to click reveal-sensitive before asserting a newly published sensitive title.
Retest community support/comments/report and article/consultation browser paths after updating that assertion.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/posts and POST /api/posts/{post_id}/comments originally returned 500 because inserted Mongo _id was included in response; fixed by excluding _id.
Mobile header intentionally hides the Masuk link; mobile tests should use the visible menu route instead.
seed_data_creation: Created isolated TEST-prefixed journal/post/comment/report/consultation data and browser test records; no seeded records modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: API suite passes 5/5. Desktop browser passed admin login and journal flow; community publish succeeded and toast appeared, but test stopped because the sensitive post title is correctly hidden until reveal. Mobile landing, menu opening, breathing interaction, and auth navigation setup passed.
rca of the issue: POST handlers inserted documents with Motor, which adds _id. Response comprehensions excluded author_id but not _id, so FastAPI jsonable_encoder raised ObjectId serialization errors (500). Excluding _id resolves both endpoints.
